notes.title: The Lacerator Launches On October 9th!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
It's been 3 long years of development, 2 years working on this project in my free time, and then 1 year of full-time development! I'm happy to finally announce that THE LACERATOR has a release date!

Drum rolls.....

THE LACERATOR LAUNCHES ON OCTOBER 9TH! 

You'll soon be able to step into the shoes of Max and find your way out of this psycho's hideout, hopefully in one piece! 

This is a really special game to me that I truly handcrafted and I'm excited as hell to release it and hear what people think about it, see players' reactions, laughs, scares etc. We also have another surprise, here you go, the grindhouse release date trailer! See ya in a few weeks  

Fernando Tittz

notes.title: New Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 


We have just launched a new demo of The Lacerator!  

We are working very hard on the full game and wanted to let you taste a bit more of how the laceration system affects the player and the areas you can access!  

If you have played the original demo, I encourage you to download this new one and try taking a different path, you’ll get surprised!  


[previewyoutube="ikPIda7nMa4;full"][/previewyoutube]DEMO CHANGES
New playable areas!

Multiple New Endings

Added Laser Sights to guns  

New Puzzles  

New Cutscenes  

New Lacerations  

You can get your legs cut off and crawl around to access unique areas  

You can get your penis cut off!  

New Items and Special Weapons

The Man in the Wall

A mysterious character you can trade items with

New first-time start up options screens  

New SEXY Logo  

A bunch of general bug fixes and polish



The demo is available for review too, and we are very excited to know what you think about it! The release date is getting closer and closer and we appreciate all your juicy feedback.  Can you adapt and survive?  


NOW AVAILABLE IN 4K
(this is a joke the graphics are still f*cked up)) 

Have fun 😄 

- Games From The Abyss

notes.title: The Lacerator Dev Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It's been a while since you've been updated on the progress that's been made in The Lacerator, and we wanted to keep you all in the loop! Games From The Abyss has been toiling away in Max's journey, and he can't wait for you all to see what's in store (Like the new badass Key Art)!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734692/8f59da61a2331dfc217321ff57bbc8210c234695.png

We wanted to try and do one of these occasionally to show off some environments, enemies, and weapons or just random things Fernando has made for the game. 

Meet...

THE MINDLESS CRAWLER

The Mindless Crawler will chase Max around the Lacerators labyrinth. Even without legs, he still has to end Max's life one way or another because if Max doesn’t finish them off, The Lacerator will rip them to shreds in his furious rage. As you can see, he has a bomb strapped to his back, which will go off when he gets close to Max. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734692/272cfa3bdf44ff97876d237aa2133d72a24c3a37.gif

Max will have to be fast or have good aim to take these guys down before their bomb goes off! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734692/94aa986becf259288197ba08d379c3ef6652531d.gif


We are excited to start showing off more of what goes into making The Lacerator, especially as we go into launch year!

If you experience terror for more than 4 hours while playing THE LACERATOR, please seek professional help!

[previewyoutube=OPU3Su1cm1o;full][/previewyoutube]

Developer Games From The Abyss and publisher DreadXP form an unholy tryst as they join as one in the creation of THE LACERATOR, a gore-soaked survival horror game so low-brow it isn’t even allowed near an art museum.

Bursting at the seams with the grime and charm of the 80’s grindhouse, THE LACERATOR is coming to a small screen near you soon.
